function.name: create_Recommender_Model
function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

Below is a practical, step‑by‑step guide you can follow to build a modern, scalable frontend for your e‑commerce site. I’ll cover the whole pipeline—from choosing a tech stack to deploying and maintaining the product—so you can pick the parts that fit your team’s skill set and business goals. --- ## 1️⃣ Define the Scope & Gather Requirements | What | Why | How | |------|-----|-----| | **Core Features** | Shopping cart, product catalog, checkout, user accounts, admin panel, reviews, search, filters, recommendations, payment gateway, shipping, analytics | List them in a product backlog; prioritize by business value. | | **Target Audience** | Mobile‑first vs desktop‑first | Decide responsive strategy early. | | **Performance Goals** | Page load < 2 s, 90 % of users see first paint < 1 s | Use Lighthouse benchmarks. | | **Accessibility** | WCAG 2.1 AA compliance | Add ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, color contrast checks. | | **SEO** | Product pages indexed, rich snippets | Server‑side rendering or static pre‑rendering. | | **Security** | PCI‑DSS compliance, XSS/CSRF protection | HTTPS, CSP headers, secure cookies. | --- ## 2️⃣ Choose Your Tech Stack | Category | Options | Pros | Cons | |----------|---------|------|------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular, Svelte | React: huge ecosystem, component reuse.
Vue: simpler learning curve, flexible.
Angular: opinionated, built‑in services.
Svelte: compile‑time optimizations. | React: boilerplate.
Angular: heavy.
Vue: smaller community. | | **State Management** | Redux / Zustand / Vuex / Pinia | Centralized store, predictable updates. | Boilerplate, learning curve. | | **Styling** | Tailwind CSS, Styled‑Components, SCSS, CSS Modules | Tailwind: utility‑first, rapid prototyping.
